description: Warm rules-only synthetic checks; three measurements per case, sequential processes, median milliseconds. Not a statistical or hardware-independent comparison.
machine: Windows, Intel i5-1135G7, 16 GB RAM, Python 3.14

stages.source: 0fb65da baseline; old less strict nightly filter
intermediate; checked every night separately for every hotel
final candidate; shared peak night per destination

limitations: Runs were not interleaved, system load and caches were uncontrolled. Inputs are synthetic; the baseline and final filter have different correctness, so these numbers do not prove a general speedup.
